notes.title: Season Customisation Feature Deep Dive
notes.content:
Welcome Team Principals! 

It's lights out time again! As a new season approaches, we're rolling out the latest update for F1® Manager 24 from the garage, our biggest update yet packed with some big features we know you'll love to try out! Update 1.11 will be available from Tuesday 25th February. We'll be sharing the full list of changes, bug fixes and additions in the Update 1.11 changelog when it releases. 

F1® Manager 24’s latest feature update brings a series first on Tuesday 25th February, [b]introducing the brand-new ability to customise seasons[/b] in Create A Team mode. This new feature enables you to extend some of the customisation options of Create A Team to the entire grid, move existing drivers and staff between teams, create your own drivers and staff, and more. 

Let’s dive into the details! 

[h3]Team Lineups[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922028/fc11b813e6b126938890eb27a45d882c6c6a0571.jpg[/img]

When starting a new Create A Team career, you will now be presented with a suite of customisation options to make the experience your own, starting with your ability to modify the line up of the other 10 teams on the grid. 

Ever wanted to see that dream driver pairing at Ferrari, or see how certain drivers and race engineers would work together? At the start of a new Create A Team career, you can now choose the drivers and staff for each team, or you can leave seats vacant and allow silly season to unfold in front of your eyes!  

[h3]Custom Drivers and Staff [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922028/719709e73aefe7eee506a9228010c12b061eb9a5.jpg[/img]

This update not only allows customisation of the other teams on the grid and the structure of the season, you can now also create and customise your very own drivers and staff. 

When creating new staff and drivers you can configure: 
[list]
[*] Name 
[*] Photo (from a selection of pre-generated staff photos) 
[*] Gender 
[*] Age 
[*] Nationality (yes, this means generated staff now all have nationalities!) 
[*] Marketability 
[*] Experience (How seasoned a driver or staff member is, effects their mentality.) 
[*] Acclaim (How renowned the staff member is within the motoring world; this effects their mentality) 
[*] Development rate 
[*] Aggression 
[*] Staff attributes like driving stats or Staff member abilities
[/list]
Custom drivers and staff can be created for all 11 teams on the grid, so you can create an entirely new set of talent to compete or mix your custom creations with existing drivers and staff from the sport. 

While there's a cap on the number of new staff you can create, we've ensured you can replace the entire grid if you want! Any unused free agents you create will transfer to the in-game pool when starting, giving you the ability to create a few up-and-coming rookies or the ultimate championship winning duo. 

Build your dream line ups and create unique scenarios; make Williams the best team on the grid and try to catch them, replace all the F1® drivers with high achieving rookies, or race as the champions with a low spec car and a field of high achieving teams behind you. The possibilities are endless and you have total control! 

[h3]Starting Conditions [/h3]

A selection of starting options that were previously available to your own created team are also now applicable to your rivals. Tweak the starting balance, facility levels and car performance levels of all teams to create the ideal canvas for racing. 

Do you strengthen a historic manufacturer to former glory, give yourself a greater challenge, or start everyone on a level playing field? The choice is yours. 

[h3]Race Calendar [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922028/d1c24058f2c522326ecafb4cc1660bcf5a1e61b6.jpg[/img]

The new customisation options also extend to the championship itself. You now have the ability to re-order or remove races from the calendar, with a minimum limit of 8 per year. You can also determine which of the race weekends include high-octane Sprint sessions before the main event. 

Create your dream calendar of races that benefit a particular driving style or construct a harsh series of races that’ll punish all but the most balanced cars. 

The replayability doesn’t end there! At the end of every season, in both Create a Team or Career mode, you now have the option to randomise the race calendar order and create a fresh challenge for your save. 

You will have 3 choices: 
[list]
[*] Keep current: Maintain the same race lineup as the current season 
[*] Partial: Shuffle ~30% of the races 
[*] Full randomisation: Change everything! 
[/list]
When selecting an option the current number of races (and Sprints) will stay the same, but the order and which races are Sprints will be shuffled. 

[h3]Rules and Regs [/h3]

Alongside race calendar customisation, rules and regulations can also be adjusted – giving you the ability to alter the fundamental rules of F1® within your custom save file. Determine the points allocation awarded throughout a race weekend, add or remove restraints to Aerodynamic testing and Powertrain limits, and even set up the Cost cap and Prize money allocation. 

Take the future of the sport into your own hands and modify the regulations to match your predictions for upcoming seasons or go your own way and deregulate for extensive testing. 

Your season setup can also be saved as its own preset so you can easily come back and start a new game with subtle changes. 

[h3]Choose Your Starting Team[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922028/cc231d35ca063912b90de89db3e5714fd75b7581.jpg[/img]

You can now also choose which team you start with when beginning a Create a Team save. After setting up your custom team, configuring the season, customising the drivers and staff, you may THEN decide to start the season with whichever team you like, not just your created team. 

Feeling like a new challenge? Create a competitive custom team and then prove your worth by beating them with an established, unmodified constructor. Or make tweaks galore to the other teams on the grid before leading your custom team to glory in a truly unique lineup of competitors. 

This free update gives you ultimate control over the F1® landscape like never before, setting you up for success, or the toughest of challenges. With these new customisation tools in F1® Manager 2024, you now have the opportunity to create the season on your terms. 

[b]Update 1.11 for F1® Manager 2024 arrives on Tuesday 25th February[/b], alongside a host of fixes, changes AND two new free cosmetic DLC packs! Check out the full patch notes on the day, and we’ll see you on the grid.

notes.title: Update 1.9 - New Features Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Welcome back to Frontier HQ Team Principals! 

Whilst you’ve been delivering pole positions and World Championships, we’ve been hard at work in the factory since launch, and we’re now excited to lift the covers off Update 1.9, the next major update for F1® Manager 2024. We’re adding some highly requested new features to the game, so let’s get straight into the details! 

[h2]Pit Lane Starts[/h2] 
Pitlane starts are now fully supported in F1® Manager 24! Using the real-world regulations as a base, these bring an additional level of authenticity to the game. Parc fermé rules take effect from whenever your car first goes on track during Q1 or SQ1; a strict list of rules is then applied: 

[list]
[*] Front wing angle can be changed.  
[*] Like-for-like parts can be swapped (For example, a broken wing can be replaced with another wing of the same design.) 
[*] Swapping non-like-for-like parts incurs a pitlane start. 
[*] Component changes will result in a pitlane start (i.e. engines, gearboxes etc). 
[*] All other setup changes will incur a pitlane start. 
[*] Cars starting from the pitlane may not exit the pitlane until they receive the greenlight, which is only given when the starting grid has fully passed the exit of the pitlane.[/list] 

We're excited to see how you navigate these new limitations, but don't worry about keeping your F1 rulebook to hand, you'll be fully prompted before making a change which will incur a penalty! Can you turn a bad qualifying or mechanical fault into a tactical advantage later in the season?  

We've also gone back over the Starting Grid scenarios from this season and ensured any cars which started from the pitlane in the real races now also start from the pitlane in the game to ensure you're able to challenge yourself as you seek to replay the races from the official 2024 season so far, can you make points from the pitlane? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922028/80ff86c1dcf1dd532bd702a3c613b0d628b4f3e6.png[/img]

[h2]Driver Development Focus[/h2] 
You can now focus drivers into distinct areas of development in order to use their skills to benefit your team. This includes your affiliates, giving you an extra reason to seek out the right people to fill your affiliate slots with the skills to enhance your team how you see fit. There are three ways you can choose to deploy the drivers in your stable.... 

[b]Driver Development:[/b] Drivers continue to focus on themselves and increasing their own abilities. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922028/7794384a69a3e8ce68a3ad713b096e5c13641ae1.png[/img]
 
[b]Car Development:[/b] Drivers use their skills to boost the research & design of car parts, reducing the time it takes to complete that research. They also contribute to increasing preparedness heading into races, giving a setup boost. As you'd expect, the amount your driver can assist is based on their expertise; more experienced drivers will have a larger effect than drivers new to the series. The effects of this focus stack, meaning you can deploy up to three of your drivers to give a bigger boost! However, bear in mind that drivers focusing on car development will temporarily sacrifice their development rates to do so.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922028/9171a2d58e4c10e37768fb3f8a32d186537d709b.png[/img]

[b]Marketability:[/b] Use your drivers’ marketability to help you meet your sponsorship goals more easily. Do you choose to send your young hotshots out or use your more seasoned drivers to make a bigger impact? Meeting your sponsorship goals more easily means less distraction to the wider team at the cost of reducing that driver's focus. Drivers focusing on marketability gain an increase in their own marketability temporarily while focusing on this area while dropping their own development rate. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922028/20c003b59043a6e8ddfb1756bab55a6892587f04.png[/img]

The intensity of a driver’s contribution to these areas increases over time, you'll need to keep drivers focused for at least a month to see the full effect, moving a driver to a new focus will reset the intensity of their contribution, so choose when to deploy certain drivers carefully to maximise the impact and minimise the disruption. 

[h2]Team suitability [/h2]
We know the task of recruiting the right people for your team can be tricky – this is where the brand new "Team Suitability" rating comes in to help. This suitability rating is uncovered as part of the process when scouting potential staff members and gives you a broad view of if this person is right for your team whilst listing out the reasoning. A variety of factors, including rating vs current staff members, salary, buy out, Championship standing and more are taken into consideration to help give you an initial indication of how well this person could fare within your team. The results are dynamic, and things like your own team’s bank balance and Championship standing will affect the rating, as always, it's you as Team Principal who makes the final decision, but this new feature will give you a basic underlying idea of your compatibility.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922028/c0088788f15835d6aede243fe367ba611549ef76.png[/img]

In addition to informing you how potential staff might fit into your team, all staff members in the game now have an opinion of your team. This means you will now find staff members in other teams might not be interested in hearing a contract proposal from you! If you are a backmarker team, don't expect staff in a Championship winning team to be willing to take a risk on joining you, even if your bank balance is flush! Every staff member's opinion is unique to them, so you may find soon-to-be out of contract staff are more open to joining teams outside their comfort zone. Just like Team Suitability; their views of you change dynamically, so make sure you're best placed to pick up key staff through the year as opinions change.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922028/f0776a91642beca88ca2762e16ccc9781249f1e3.png[/img]

[h2]Feedback on Contracts in the game world [/h2]
"Silly season" comes to F1® Manager! We've added some additional content to emulate what goes on in the world of F1® within F1® Manager. Your scouting team and the F1® journalists have been busy and will send you some new high-value information to help you navigate the world of signings and contracts that was previously behind closed doors! 

[b]Contract rumours:[/b] You'll now receive a condensed report from your scouting team about high value targets that are currently in negotiations with other teams. This is your chance to act quickly and convince someone you might have your eye on, before they sign for a rival. Your team even has the scouting reports ready for you to jump in and start negotiations if you see fit. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922028/edcc69d84aacbe45c99684632cac765b07ac08c2.png[/img]

[b]Summer Signings:[/b] When other teams make key signings, you'll now find out about when it happens and be able to plan accordingly. Find out about those big-name signings in the news just as you'd expect in real life, and immerse yourself in all the off-track action. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922028/8b9ef8051d5a622fa0fea643e876eaa181be1e71.png[/img]

[h2]Engine payments [/h2]
We've been listening to your feedback and we're making a slight change to how you pay for your engines: instead of a lump sum payable on the 1st of January, we're now making this instalment-based to spread the cost over the year, payable on the 1st of each month. This should help budgeting for your team and ensure you don't have a difficult start to the year especially in season two when your engine payment is first due. This will take effect from the next new season you experience in the game. 
 

[h3]Update 1.9 to F1® Manager 24 arrives on Monday 18th November, alongside a host of fixes and changes – check out the full patch notes on the day, and we’ll see you on the grid. [/h3]

F1® Manager 24 is the ultimate Formula 1®  management simulation, offering unparalleled control over a F1® team as you create a legacy for the record books.

Plan and direct your team’s strategy and watch as your driver’s execute your commands in thrilling F1®  races, brought to life with a broadcast-quality presentation. Manage your drivers, staff, car development and facilities throughout multiple seasons to give your team the best chance to claim a spot on the Formula 1 podium.

[u][h3]What's new in F1® Manager 24?[/h3][/u]
A new Formula 1® season has arrived, and with it, the most comprehensive F1® management experience to date.

F1® Manager 24 offers a number of new additions including:

[b]Create a Team[/b] - For the first time in the series, create your own team to challenge the grid and forge a new legacy.
[b]Mentality System[/b] - Manage the personalities and needs of your staff and drivers in the pursuit of success.

[b]Even More[/b] - 2024 F1® Sprint race format, 2024 driver and staff roster, improved approachability, full race weekend simulation, enhanced tutorials, the return of Race Replay and more!
We’ll be diving deeper into many of F1® Manager 24’s new features over the coming months, so be sure to check out the feature timeline for key dates on more details.

[u][h3]Will F1® Manager 24 feature Team Switching at launch?[/h3][/u]
Yes. All features available in F1® Manager 22 and F1® Manager 23 will be available from launch day, including the ability to switch team and the difficulty options that were introduced to F1® Manager 23 after launch.

English, French, German, Italian, Spanish (Spain), Spanish (Mexico), Brazilian Portuguese, Dutch, Japanese, Simplified Chinese

F1® Manager 24 will be available to play on July 23 2024.

[h2]Lead your team to glory in F1® Manager 2024, launching this Summer.[/h2]

A new Formula 1® season has arrived, packed with 24 races, new cars, new Team Principals and an updated F1® Sprint race format. Start your career as one of 10 official F1® teams or create your own for the very first time.

[previewyoutube=oRgrPDHCoHg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Create a Team[/h3]
Create your own custom team to challenge the grid and forge a new legacy. Customise every element of your team from your setup and livery design to logo and racing suits. Recruit the right staff and drivers and negotiate with sponsors for placement on your car.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44149572/c114256dd8ff662d8a5c5f9b9c8157032707aa6b.jpg[/img]

[h3]Deeper Management[/h3]
Keep your drivers and staff motivated using the comprehensive new mentality system and dynamic contract negotiations. Take control of your team’s facilities and focus your driver’s development as you execute your vision. Improved rival team AI, including the new threat of staff and driver poaching, provides an unpredictable and dynamic challenge year-on-year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44149572/f04929f23a8ffc60c7b592a589b1bc0d863b0d75.jpg[/img]

[h3]F1 Races Brought To Life[/h3]
Experience the thrills of an F1® race from a new perspective, with improved racing behaviour and dynamic new cameras bringing the racing simulation to life. Devise a winning strategy for every race and give your drivers commands to maximise results but be wary of mechanical failures disrupting even the strongest of strategies.
